claims.text: The route deviation is established on this trip's own GPS trace, and the rider clears the POL-RD-08(a) same-trip burden while doing it: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00107 on a consistent timeline (requested 21:07:30, started 21:13:40, ended 21:47:40). EV-GPS-00107 records a trace_distance_km of 17.57 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff; the platform's optimal route for the same endpoints is 14.00 km on EV-TRIP-00107. The excess is 3.57 km, 25.5% of optimal, which clears both POL-RD-01 limbs - more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% of optimal. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing figure and forbids citing the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.6 for the threshold test. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00107 is tagged IMPAIRED at weight 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED; what that discount does and does not do is argued in the next claim.

The trace's schema impairment is not a policy impairment, and the Judge must say both things. POL-RD-07(a) to (c) requires one of: a gap of more than 90 seconds between consecutive fixes, a straight-line jump of more than 500 m, or a sustained sampling interval above 30 seconds. EV-GPS-00107 has gaps: [] and max_gap_sec 0.0, a steady 10-second sample interval against an expected 10 seconds, and its worst artefact is the 331.8 m multipath jump on the Raffles Place final approach - under the 500 m limb, exactly as the admissibility note records. POL-RD-07 therefore does not bite, no independent corroboration is mandated by that clause, and the deviation may still be established on the trace; the only consequence of the 0.30 weight is a down-weight of the Judge's confidence under POL-GEN-02, on an artifact the pre-pass itself says remains usable.

Corroboration beyond the trace exists in any event, and POL-RD-08 obliges the rider to supply it: the rider's own counters are deviation_claims_60d 5 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 1 on EV-RPROF-00107, and this claim's excess is 25.5%, under 30%, so POL-RD-08's fourth sentence applies. It is satisfied from outside the trace. The driver's own counterparty_statement admits the route taken: 'I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it.' And EV-CHAT-00107 shows the rider putting the Whitley exit to him - 'why exit at whitley? CTE goes straight down what' - with the driver not denying the exit but answering 'cte very jam tonight boss'. POL-RD-07(ii) names a counterparty statement admitting the route as exactly this class of independent corroboration, and POL-RD-08 says the factor may never be used to deny a claim that is otherwise proven.

The driver's explanation does not exonerate him. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory that names a road, expressway segment or junction the optimal route traverses and carries a validity window overlapping the time the trace would reach that segment. There is no such artifact: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, with a BLOCKING MISSING_ARTIFACT issue - no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE on the evening of 18 July 2026. The driver's 'CTE very jam tonight boss' names no artifact and no road segment, and POL-RD-08 provides that a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge the driver's burden once the rider has shown the excess. With nothing to exonerate, POL-RD-03's cap never runs and no part of the 3.57 km excess is set aside.

The driver cannot fall back on a rider-requested detour. POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction in the chat log that identifies a place or road specifically enough to act on, corroborated by a waypoint_hint the vehicle passes within 200 m of. EV-CHAT-00107 contains exactly one rider message and it is a challenge to the detour, not a request for one, and both messages carry waypoint_hint null. On the clause's own terms the corroboration test is undecidable, the clause is unavailable, and the ruling must record that the test could not be run.

The refund is then arithmetic, not discretionary. EV-FARE-00107 shows fare_model METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs and the upfront-fare clause POL-RD-11 has no application. Surge lives on the fare breakdown and nowhere else - EV-FARE-00107 carries surge_multiplier 1.35 - so recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.00 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 platform fee = 29.177, with no ERP, tolls, surcharge or waiting-time fee to add. The rider was charged 36.60 (EV-FARE-00107, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.0). Refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, which is not rounded at any intermediate step and is rounded up at the end to SGD 7.45. That is 20.3% of charged_total - above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so not NO_ACTION, and far below the 90% that would make it a FULL_REFUND under POL-RD-06(b) or POL-RD-02's closing sentence. The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45 and the ruling should state charged_total, recomputed_fare and the refund on separate lines.

No pass-through correction is added on top of that figure, and none is double-counted. EV-FARE-00107 records erp_gantries: [] and a tolls_erp of 0.0, with an off-optimal-route ERP total of 0.00 and no airport surcharge line on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. POL-RD-09 therefore has nothing to refund and nothing to add, and the rider does not ask for a line the fare breakdown does not carry. The SGD 7.45 above is the whole of the rider's recovery.

The rider's remaining profile counters are context only and cannot be converted into an adverse finding about this trip. POL-GEN-01 makes only deviation_claims_60d and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated citable, and only for the POL-RD-08 corroboration test - which is answered in the third claim above. The high lifetime counters on EV-RPROF-00107 (lifetime_trips 268, prior_disputes_filed 9, prior_disputes_upheld 2, prior_no_show_flags 1, rating 4.44, cancellation_rate 0.11) may inform how closely the rider's assertions are read and nothing more; a finding built on them is discarded on the same footing as an uncited claim, and the ruling must say so.

claims.text: Even on the trace's own figure, the excess over the booked optimal is 3.57 km and 25.5% of the 14.0 km optimal. That may clear POL-RD-01's establishment gates, but it sits below BOTH materiality gates set in the same clause — 8.0 km absolute and 50% — so any deviation here is an ordinary, non-MATERIAL one. POL-RD-06's uplift to a full refund is keyed to a MATERIAL deviation and is unavailable, and the ceiling on any rider remedy is the POL-RD-02 recomputation, not the whole fare.

POL-RD-06 asks whether driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more, or is at least 5% of driver_profile.completed_trips_90d with at least 40 trips. This driver sits at deviation_flags_90d of 1 against completed_trips_90d of 619 — a rate of 0.0016 — and the raw count is below the alternative limb as well. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) nor the conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) can follow, and POL-GEN-01 confines the rest of the profile to context only.

For the record, and because POL-GEN-02 requires disclosure: the GPS trace is impaired at admissibility weight 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED — a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final approach into Raffles Place. The driver does not present it as clean. But the outlier is under POL-RD-07's 500 m jump limb, there is no gap over 90 seconds and no sustained sampling interval over 30 seconds, so the trace is NOT impaired for policy purposes and no straight-line substitution is triggered. The discount bites on confidence only, under POL-GEN-02(2).

The excess can only be measured on gps_trace.trace_distance_km: POL-RD-01 expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km as a rounded convenience copy, and the fare_breakdown's distance_charged_km of 17.60 against a 17.57 trace is the same measurement carried across rather than an independent source. The deciding fact therefore rests on a single artifact at weight 0.30, and POL-GEN-02(2) caps the Judge's confidence at 0.30 — below the platform-wide 0.70 floor. POL-RD-10(1) then makes escalation mandatory: the disputed amount is held for a human reviewer rather than collected or refunded.

The driver's account is that the CTE southbound into town was jammed and that he diverted via Newton and Kim Seng — a route-based exoneration claim under POL-RD-03. No traffic advisory covers that corridor: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight 0.0. An exculpatory route claim asserted against an artifact that is missing from the pool, with no traffic_advisory to support it, is the exact circumstance POL-RD-10(5) names, and the case must go to a human reviewer with no monetary ruling.

The fare carries no ERP or toll lines at all — erp_gantries is empty and the on-optimal-route, off-route and toll totals are all 0.00. There is accordingly no off-route pass-through charge for POL-RD-09 to correct and no billing-integrity line the rider can recover on top of any distance refund, so the money in issue is bounded by the distance-and-time recomputation alone.

ruling.explanation: To both parties. Trip TRP-00107, 18 July 2026, Ang Mo Kio to Raffles Place. The deviation is ESTABLISHED. POL-RD-01 measures the actual distance on the GPS trace and the optimal on the trip record. EV-GPS-00107 gives a trace distance of 17.57 km; EV-TRIP-00107 gives an optimal of 14.00 km. The excess is 3.57 km, 25.5% of optimal. That clears both establishment gates (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so a deviation exists. It is below both materiality gates (8.0 km and 50%), so this is an ordinary deviation and POL-RD-06's uplift to a full refund does not apply. The GPS trace and the confidence cap. EV-GPS-00107 is IMPAIRED at the admissibility layer — weight 0.30, issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the Raffles Place final approach) — but it is NOT impaired for policy under POL-RD-07: no gap over 90 s (max gap 0.0 s), no jump over 500 m, no sustained sampling interval over 30 s. I say both things, as the clause requires. The 0.30 weight bears on confidence only. The finding survives that discount: the route is carried independently by the chat log EV-CHAT-00107 (weight 1.0), which records the rider putting the Whitley exit to the driver and the driver not denying it, and by the driver's own counterparty statement ("I went by Newton and Kim Seng"). Under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is the higher of the independent carriers — 1.0 — not the 0.30 of the down-weighted trace alone; bundle_integrity_score is context and is not the cap. The driver's traffic excuse does not exonerate him. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic advisory naming the affected corridor with an overlapping validity window. There is none: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE that evening. "CTE very jam tonight boss" is a general assertion unsupported by any advisory ID; under POL-RD-08 it does not discharge the driver's burden and sets aside no part of the excess. POL-RD-04 does not apply either: the only rider message challenges the detour rather than requesting one, and both messages carry waypoint_hint null, so the clause's corroboration test could not be run. The refund. EV-FARE-00107 shows fare_model METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs and the upfront-fare clause POL-RD-11 has no application. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 14.00 + 0.28 × 24.0) × 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177, using the surge_multiplier 1.35 read from the fare breakdown. Charged_total = 36.60. Refund = 36.60 − 29.177 = 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% full-refund share. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: the fare carries no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge, so the 7.45 is the whole of the recovery and no pass-through correction is double-counted. No driver compensation is due, the billed distance not being less than the trace. Profile. POL-RD-06's repeat-deviation check is not met — deviation_flags_90d 1 against completed_trips_90d 619 — so there is no conduct referral. The high lifetime counters on the rider's profile (lifetime_trips, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld, prior_no_show_flags, rating, cancellation_rate) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and no finding rests on them. Ruling: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45; the charge of SGD 36.60 stands less that refund.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: this concerns trip TRP-00107, Ang Mo Kio to One Raffles Place on the night of 18 July 2026, charged at SGD 36.60. I find the driver did leave the optimal route and had no valid excuse for it; the rider is refunded SGD 7.45 and the balance of the charge stands.

THE DEVIATION. POL-RD-01 sets the test and names its own governing field: gps_trace.trace_distance_km. On EV-GPS-00107 that is 17.57 km; the platform's optimal route on EV-TRIP-00107 is 14.00 km. The excess is 3.57 km, or 25.5% of optimal, clearing both establishment limbs (over 0.8 km and over 20%). I have deliberately not used trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.6, which POL-RD-01 forbids as a rounded copy. The excess is under both materiality gates (8.0 km and 50%), so this is an ordinary, non-MATERIAL deviation and no full-refund uplift arises.

THE GPS TRACE — IMPAIRED, BUT USABLE. I name EV-GPS-00107 as impaired at weight 0.30, issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED: a 331.8 m multipath jump on the final approach into Raffles Place implying impossible speeds. But POL-RD-07 uses different, looser thresholds, and for policy purposes the trace is clean — no gap over 90 s (largest 0.0 s), no jump over 500 m (worst 331.8 m), no sustained interval over 30 s (a steady 10 s). The two are not the same thing and I say both: the trace is schema-impaired yet policy-usable, and the deviation may be established on it. The 0.30 weight bites on my confidence only, under POL-GEN-02(2); it does not trigger POL-RD-10(3).

INDEPENDENCE AND CONFIDENCE. The fact that the driver left the corridor does not rest on the trace alone. It is carried independently by the contemporaneous in-trip chat, EV-CHAT-00107 (weight 1.0), in which the rider asks 'why exit at whitley? CTE goes straight down what' and the driver answers 'cte very jam tonight boss' without denying the exit; and it is admitted in the driver's own statement ('I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it'). Because a weight-1.0 artifact carries the same fact independently of the impaired trace, the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is the maximum of the independent carriers, 1.0 — not the trace's 0.30 — and my confidence is 0.85.

THE RIDER'S CORROBORATION DUTY. Under POL-RD-08 (deviation_claims_60d 5 against deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 1, on a claim under 30%) the rider needed support beyond the trace. It is met: the driver's counterparty statement admits the route, which POL-RD-07(ii) names as an independent source. That factor is not used to deny a claim that is otherwise proven.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. The driver says the CTE was jammed. POL-RD-03 exonerates only where a traffic_advisory names a road the optimal route uses, with a window covering the time. There is none: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) and no congestion advisory was issued. A general assertion that traffic was bad, with no advisory to point to, does not discharge the driver's burden (POL-RD-08). None of the 3.57 km is set aside on this ground.

NO RIDER-REQUESTED DETOUR. POL-RD-04 is unavailable. Its test needs a waypoint_hint the vehicle passes within 200 m of; both chat messages carry waypoint_hint null, and the rider's message challenges the route rather than requesting it. On the clause's own terms the corroboration test cannot be run, and I record that it could not be run.

THE REFUND. EV-FARE-00107 shows fare_model METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 has no application. The surge multiplier is read from EV-FARE-00107, where it is 1.35 — not from the trip record, which does not carry the field. On separate lines: charged_total SGD 36.60; recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.00 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = SGD 29.177 (not rounded at any intermediate step); refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = SGD 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45. That is 20.3% of the charge — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so not NO_ACTION, and far below the 90% that would make it a full refund. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: there are no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge, so there is no pass-through correction to make and nothing is double-counted.

PROFILES. The repeat-deviation check under POL-RD-06 shows no pattern (deviation_flags_90d 1 against completed_trips_90d 619), so there is no full-refund uplift and no conduct referral. The remaining profile counters on both sides — rating, cancellation_rate, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld, prior_no_show_flags, prior_deviation_flags, acceptance_rate and the rest — are context only under POL-GEN-01 and have carried no finding about this trip.

OUTCOME: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45 to the rider. No driver compensation is due (the driver was billed for 17.60 km against a 17.57 km trace, so there is no unbilled distance). No clause produces a referral, so no referral is made.
